messages.text: Saturday, September 26 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Overcast Skies, Community Events Abound

An overcast but mild Saturday offers a range of local activities, from community gatherings in Ypsilanti to musical performances in Detroit. The University of Michigan advances cancer research with a new center.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 73°F and a low around 48°F.
Sunrise is at 7:26 AM, sunset at 7:24 PM, with a full moon, 99.7% illuminated.
Discover Local Flavors and Sounds
The Big Read Kickoff at YDL-Michigan Library Plaza begins at 11:00 AM, offering live performances and local history. For music lovers, The Ark in Ann Arbor hosts The Bros. Landreth at 7:30 PM.
September 30th marks both My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor Council Allocates Downtown Lot Sale Funds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a plan to allocate between $14.2 million and $17.4 million from the sale of the Kline's lot. The funds will support 12 different projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy.
Sunday Offers Art and Comedy
Tomorrow, catch the Jazz Fest at The Ravens Club in Ann Arbor starting at 2:00 PM, or enjoy comedy with Colin Mochrie & Brad Sherwood at Sound Board at MotorCity Casino Hotel at 7:30 PM.
Soundwave Cancer Treatments Advance at U-M

The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to research soundwave-based cancer treatments. NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation.
The schedule for the next Starship launch is unset; Next Spaceflight estimates no earlier than September 18, 2026.
Seek out a quiet moment, and let the day unfold.
Sunday, September 27 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Clear Autumn Day in Canton
A mostly clear and warm autumn day awaits Canton, with a high near 76°F. The evening brings a full moon, and local events offer a variety of music and art.
Today will be mostly clear with a high near 76°F and a low around 48°F.
Sunrise is at 7:27 AM, sunset at 7:22 PM, and the full moon will be 99.5% illuminated.
Sunday's Arts and Music Scene

Ann Arbor's Kerrytown Concert House hosts two afternoon events: an artist reception for 'A Symphony of Seeing' at 4 PM and 'A Tale of Two Quintets with Kathryn Goodson and Friends' also at 4 PM. In the evening, catch the Women in Jazz Showcase at Ann Arbor's Blue LLaMA Jazz Club at 6 PM.
This coming Wednesday, September 30, marks both My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor Council Approves Spending Plan for Downtown Lot Sale

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a plan to allocate $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline's lot. The funds will support 12 distinct projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy initiatives.
Monday Brings Music and History
Tomorrow, Detroit hosts 'Drumming on the Riverfront' in the evening. Ann Arbor offers a 'Sewing Lab' at the Downtown Library and a presentation on 'Fall Gardening Chores' at YDL-Whittaker.
Space Telescopes Clear Reviews, Lunar Lander Tests Begin

NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review, moving toward final launch preparations. Meanwhile, NASA has begun its most flight-relevant lunar landing plume tests at Langley to validate rocket exhaust models.
The next Starship launch does not have an official date, with estimates suggesting no earlier than September 18, 2026.
May your day be filled with quiet discoveries.
